prediction_question: For an earthquake detected by BMKG's national seismic network in Indonesia, will the event be reported as felt by the public (appear in the 'gempabumi dirasakan' product), given only instrumental parameters known at detection: magnitude, hypocenter depth, epicenter location and origin time?
prediction_time: The network's automatic processing instant for the event (minutes after origin): magnitude/depth/location are knowable then, and felt reports arrive only afterwards from the public reporting process.
target_definition: Binary felt / not-felt for a detected event: positive iff the event appears in BMKG's felt-earthquake product, negative iff it appears in the instrumental catalogue without a felt entry. The label source is BMKG's felt-report product (a documented public-report collection process), which is a later product than the features and never ships as a feature.

sources.name: Data Terbuka BMKG - earthquake feeds (Data Gempabumi Terbuka)
sources.api: anonymous JSON/XML feeds enumerated from the page: DataMKG/TEWS/autogempa.json, gempaterkini.json, gempadirasakan.json (plus .xml variants) - all answer HTTP 200 with no key; access limit 60 requests/min per IP
sources.license: attribution-mandatory terms measured on the pages: 'Wajib untuk mencantumkan BMKG ... sebagai sumber data dan menampilkannya pada aplikasi/sistem Anda' (must cite BMKG as source and display it); no named formal licence (no CC-BY or similar) - a usage mandate, redistribution posture otherwise unstated
sources.access: anonymous, no key, but every open earthquake product serves only the latest 15 events (measured) - no historical archive exposed

license_evidence: Measured 2026-10-20 from data.bmkg.go.id pages: the open-data pages mandate attribution ('Wajib untuk mencantumkan BMKG sebagai sumber data') and set a 60 req/min/IP limit, but no named reuse licence. Attribution-required terms are manageable per the standing policy, but a source silent on redistribution is not publishable without an explicit answer - recorded as part of the park, not assumed.

measurements.feeds_2026_10_20: gempadirasakan.json: HTTP 200, 4,602 bytes, exactly 15 'Tanggal' items - the latest 15 felt events only. gempaterkini.json: HTTP 200, 4,157 bytes (latest events). The /gempabumi/ catalog page (24,466 bytes) enumerates only the autogempa/terkini/dirasakan json+xml feeds and greps clean of catalog/katalog/historis/arsip/unduh/CSV bulk-download hints.
measurements.felt_item_shape_2026_10_20: a felt-quake item carries Tanggal, Jam, DateTime (ISO), Coordinates, Lintang/Bujur, Magnitude, Kedalaman (depth) - i.e. the instrumental features and the felt designation in one record, confirming a detection-time panel is constructible if history existed.

rejection_reason: PARK (status parked), reason: the label needs historical felt/not-felt pairs, and every open earthquake product measured serves only the latest 15 events - no historical archive is exposed on the open-data pages, so split windows cannot be computed from anything published today. Unpark by (a) locating a historical catalogue with felt annotations (the SATU PETA MKG API at gis.bmkg.go.id/portal/dataapi was not probed this session and may expose one) or (b) committing to a scheduled collection loop from the live feeds - a 12-month loop would accumulate a first usable cohort (the same pattern as the Companies House park). The licence question (attribution mandate, no named licence) must also be answered before construction.
next_action: Probe https://gis.bmkg.go.id/portal/dataapi for a historical earthquake catalogue with felt annotations; if none exists, ask the operator whether to start a 12-month collection loop on the live feeds (cheap, one scheduled job) and park this until the cohort lands.
